dismissed.why_not_material: Minor timeline inconsistency between Nov 2025 guidance ('year-end 2025') and registry slippage pattern. The catalyst trial (NCT04229979) has slipped completion dates multiple times, but the most recent registry version at time of claim was consistent with year-end 2025. This is a weak operational signal, not evidence of masking catalyst trial results.

Minor timeline inconsistency where Aug 2025 guidance stated 'year-end' but registry showed Sept 2025 primary completion. This is a 3-month discrepancy in event-driven trial guidance—ordinary friction in projecting 80 events, not material masking of known results.

Evidence quality overreach for SLS009 (different program than GPS catalyst). This is about a Phase 2 comparison in a different molecule/indication, not the NCT04229979 AML GPS Phase 3 catalyst. Per principle #2, trial-specific findings only count if they concern the catalyst trial.

Although this claim references NCT04229979 (the catalyst trial) and uses cross-study benchmarks despite having a randomized control arm, the finding is minor severity and reflects standard early interim promotion (citing >13.5 month survival with <50% events vs. historical 6 months). This is normal IR color during enrollment, not masking of final results. Per principle #3, citing open-label or interim data alongside a pivotal is supporting promotion.
Evidence quality overreach for SLS009 Phase 2 (different program). Not about the GPS AML catalyst trial NCT04229979.
Evidence quality overreach for SLS009 Phase 2a DLBCL (different program). Not about the GPS AML catalyst trial NCT04229979.

Same as sls_035—references NCT04229979 but uses historical benchmark. Minor severity, reflects interim promotion of survival signal during trial conduct, not masking of topline results. The company disclosed the trial is randomized and simply added historical context for investor framing.
Evidence quality overreach for SLS009 Phase 2a (different program). Not about the GPS AML catalyst trial NCT04229979.

analyst_note: All eight refuted findings are either minor-severity timeline friction (year-end vs. Sept 2025 guidance discrepancies on an event-driven trial) or evidence-quality overreach claims about SLS009, a different program from the GPS AML Phase 3 catalyst (NCT04229979). The two findings that do reference the catalyst trial (sls_035, sls_059) involve using historical benchmarks for interim survival data during trial conduct—standard promotional color for an ongoing randomized trial, not masking of final topline results. No company-level misconduct findings were flagged. The registry shows completion slippage, but this is disclosed and consistent with event accrual dynamics. No material masking signal detected for this catalyst.
